purpose: English content for an original compact framework-development diagram and target matrix; this is not a treatment recommendation or a replacement for source ballots.
source: plan/241217 中国特应性皮炎达标治疗方案探索与验证 项目.pptx, slides 7–9; plan/达标论文-20261025-XBL-yaoxu.docx, framework methods/results

development.title: Development of the local treatment-target framework
development.legend_only: Project materials describe two questionnaire rounds, a planned 75% agreement criterion and 49 returned questionnaires. The planned stakeholder sample was 30 physicians, 10 nurses and 10 patients. Round-specific participation and item-level agreement cannot be reconstructed without the original ballots.
development.evidence_status: Documented project description; vote-level verification incomplete

assessment.title: Targets evaluated in the 24-week cohort
assessment.logic_label: From Week 4: at least one target in each row
assessment.safety_label: Review safety, tolerability and patient priorities at every visit
assessment.source_month_mapping: The source framework labels months 1, 3 and 6; the cohort operationalizes these as weeks 4, 12 and 24.
assessment.legend_only: EASI-50 and EASI-75 denote at least 50% and 75% improvement from the individual's pretreatment EASI. IGA decrease is measured from baseline. At Week 2 the target is PP-NRS ≤4, not a four-point reduction. Adult DLQI analyses use the current analysis eligibility rule; the source questionnaire contains age-specific quality-of-life instruments. Missing outcomes are not assumed to satisfy a target. IGA is the recorded local scale; it is not silently relabelled vIGA-AD. This framework was evaluated observationally, without a usual-care control arm.

planned_only.location: Supplementary framework table, not an observed cohort branch
planned_only.months2: Same target logic as month 1; low-coverage Week 8 is not a main outcome visit
planned_only.months9_and12: Clinical signs: EASI-90, IGA 0/1 or EASI ≤3. Patient experience: PP-NRS 0/1 or DLQI ≤4. Both domains required.
planned_only.scope_note: The cohort does not establish attainment or durability at months 9–12.

measurement_extension.label: Exploratory E-EASI assessment
measurement_extension.definition: E-EASI means estimated EASI; BSA plus CCL17, CCL26 and IL-5 is a hybrid clinical–molecular estimator.
measurement_extension.diagram_use: Keep separate from the consensus-development arrows. The estimator was evaluated after data collection and did not determine the original clinical decisions.

layout.preferred: Two converging evidence/stakeholder inputs, a short development chain, then a four-column target matrix. Keep the participant-flow diagram as a separate clinical-cohort panel.

reference_structures.idea: Compact decision pathway above a target matrix; separate process from numeric targets.
Converging patient and clinical inputs; explicit selection and review stages.
Parallel clinician and patient rows with an explicit AND between domains.

layout.design_constraint: Draw an original vector diagram. Do not copy published artwork or insert paragraphs inside boxes. Printed n values must represent a named population and have a reconstructable denominator.
